The shell heredoc failed with a parser error, so I wrote the file with the Write tool instead. I did not run `cat` to check the contents afterwards.

Record #25 ("verification on all builds") is also on record. It withdrew an earlier decision that isn't about the backend, so I left it out of the paragraph. The earlier decision it replaced is retired, and I didn't mention it.

Separately, the Muninn heartbeat shows RED: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That points to a hook exceeding its timeout. I didn't investigate it.
